entries.definition: (used as an intensifier) excellently
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The adverb of *superb*: surpassing praise, with a note of polish and craft.

entries.definition: lacking in physical beauty or proportion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Polite avoidance - unremarkable rather than unattractive.
examples: a plain girl with a freckled face

entries.definition: to a small degree or extent
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The adverb of *slight*: delicately built - descriptive and mild, with no sting.
examples: the children argued because one slice of cake was slightly larger than the other

entries.definition: as lifeless as a stone
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Maximally blunt - leaves no room for hope or softening.

entries.definition: in a smutty manner
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The adverb of *smutty*: the soot sense has been almost entirely displaced by the obscene one.

entries.definition: in the manner of someone who is very hungry
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The adverb of *ravenous*: hunger at full strength, and no fault in it.

entries.definition: without force or sincere effort
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The adverb of *thin*: the plain, unloaded word - it states the shape and passes no judgement.

entries.definition: without mercy or pity
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Said as easily of weather and landscape as of people, and just as final.

entries.definition: marked by refinement in taste and manners
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The British spelling; the same compliment with the same history.

entries.definition: generous in providing aid to others
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praises the disposition rather than any particular gift; often said of institutions.

entries.definition: marked by or given to doubt
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Nearly neutral - in most contexts it is what a careful person does.

entries.definition: marked by excessive complacency or self-satisfaction
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The social version: pleasure in being right, worn where others can see it.

entries.definition: showing the capacity for endurance
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: A construction rather than a word - *patient of delay* - and formal to the point of stiffness.

entries.definition: without compunction or human feeling
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names what is missing rather than what was done; harsher than *inhumane*, which describes conditions.

entries.definition: of extreme beauty
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Beauty of fine detail - praise for delicacy and craft.

entries.definition: having or showing self-esteem
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approves of a proper regard for oneself - the healthy version of pride.

entries.definition: thickly covered with ingrained dirt or soot
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Said of rooms and fabric, and the real complaint is that it is depressing.

entries.definition: (usually followed by ‘to’) full of eagerness
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: *Raring to go* - eagerness with the brakes off.

entries.definition: misleading by means of pleasant or alluring methods
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The one near-flattering word here: the deception is pleasant enough that being taken in sounds enjoyable.
examples: taken in by beguiling tales of overnight fortunes

entries.definition: criticize harshly or violently
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names an actual punishment - public humiliation, deliberately staged.

entries.definition: involving clever rogues or adventurers especially as in a type of fiction
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Not a judgement but a literary label, for the rogue-hero tradition where the trickery is the entertainment.

entries.definition: in a curious and questioning manner
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The adverb of *wondering*: curiosity with the wonder still in it, and no agenda attached.

entries.definition: praise, glorify, or honor
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise at length and without reservation - the enthusiasm is part of the meaning.
examples: extol the virtues of one's children

entries.definition: in a nice way
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The adverb of *nice*: weak from overuse; it now praises so mildly that it can read as faint disappointment.

entries.definition: in a greedy manner
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The adverb of *greedy*: the everyday charge, and one of the first moral words a child is taught.

entries.definition: of low or inferior quality
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Comparative and cold - it needs something better to exist before it means anything.

entries.definition: capable of accepting delay with equanimity
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Describes the pace and lets the character be inferred.
examples: was unhurried with the small children

entries.definition: pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Military slang - gallows humour rather than disrespect.

entries.definition: (of the elements) in a wild and stormy manner
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The adverb of *furious*: the everyday word for full anger - vivid, and still sympathetic to whoever feels it.

entries.definition: possessing or displaying courage; able to face and deal with danger or fear without flinching
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Weightier than 'brave' - implies moral choice, not just nerve.
examples: a frank courageous heart … triumphed over pain
set a courageous example by leading them safely into and out of enemy-held territory

entries.definition: worn and broken down by hard use
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The sound stands in for the condition; it suggests one more use might be too many.

entries.definition: of very poor quality; flimsy
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Dated slang for poor quality, long since overtaken by the music.

entries.definition: look about oneself
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Surveying rather than fixing on anything; no judgement either way.
examples: look around to see whether you can find the missing document

entries.definition: devouring or craving food in great quantities
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Hunger at full strength, and no fault in it.

entries.definition: in a cheerful manner
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The adverb of *cheerful*: the steady everyday word - a disposition rather than a burst of feeling.
examples: he cheerfully agreed to do it

entries.definition: resembling a beast; showing lack of human sensibility
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Denies the person's humanity outright, which is why it is reserved for atrocity.

entries.definition: tall and thin
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Loose-limbed and awkward with it.

entries.definition: devouring or craving food in great quantities
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Literary and dry, and often used of curiosity rather than food.

entries.definition: naive and easily deceived or tricked
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plain accusation - it implies a history of being fooled.
examples: at that early age she had been gullible and in love

entries.definition: look at with fixed eyes
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Long and absorbed - the word grants the looker something worth looking at.

entries.definition: smiling with happiness or optimism
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Describes the evidence rather than the mood, which is why it can be worn falsely.

entries.definition: shed tears because of sadness, rage, or pain
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plain, neutral verb - no judgement of the person or the cause.
examples: She cried bitterly when she heard the news of his death
She cried when she read the letter.

entries.definition: enduring trying circumstances with even temper or characterized by such endurance
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Endurance with an even temper - the temper is what distinguishes it from mere waiting.

entries.definition: in fear
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The adverb of *fearful*: names the fear without judging the person for it.
examples: she hurried down the stairs fearfully

entries.definition: without pity; in a merciless manner
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The adverb of *merciless*: mercy was available and was withheld; that is the entire charge.
examples: he was mercilessly trounced by his opponent in the House

entries.definition: resembling a tiger in fierceness and lack of mercy
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Fierceness by animal comparison, which softens it into a figure of speech.

entries.definition: having keenness and forcefulness and penetration in thought, expression, or intellect
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Sharp and penetrating - praise for incisive thought.

entries.definition: rebuke formally
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Official and procedural - it happens on a record, from someone with the standing to do it.

entries.definition: excellent
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Everyday enthusiasm - the common word for real approval.
examples: had a great time at the party

entries.definition: in a cheerfully buoyant manner
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The adverb of *chirpy*: british and small-scale, and grating if the hearer is not cheerful too.
